notes.title: Changelog for Update #11 v1.0.0.0 RC 5
notes.content:
[h3]Code Change[/h3]
[list]
[*] when Empire is destroyed remove all its buildings & units
[*] add buildings & units to the mainmenu background map
[*] add movement AI to units on mainmenu so they move around the map
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
[list]
[*] when building is destroyed reset the movement cost back to 1
[*] unit could attack when movement was less than 1 but more then 0
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog for Update #1 v.0.0.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Game Play[/h2]
[list]
[*]Mouse Map Movement
[list]
[*] Added support to move the game map using the left mouse button
[/list]
[*]Unit Movement
[list]
[*] Added support to move unit with right mouse button in addition to UI & hotkey activation
[/list]
[*]Unit & Building Glowing Spheres
[list]
[*] Replaced the detection boundary indicator from using the place holder image to highlighting the edge of the tiles that represent the area the unit or building can see, this is based on the vision stat
[/list]
[*]AI Turn Length
[list]
[*] Update code so units that are not visible to the player will not transition to their target cell over several frames but snap to it immediately
[/list]
[*]No Help Documents
[list]
[*] Framework has been added to include in game information, still in progress
[*] Help Documents for Icon Descriptions added
[/list][/list]

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]
[list]
[*]Continue & Load Button 
[list]
[*] Buttons not disabled when there were no saved games
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Resolution Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI not Scaling to Resolution Setting
[list]
[*] Fix setting so game would scale, hopefully..
[/list]
[*] One 1 resolution
[list]
[*] This was a demo setting but this option has been removed as game engine does not support manual resolution switching.
[/list]
[*] Game Play UI too small
[list]
[*] increased UI scale & added camera zoom support
[/list]
[*] Horizontal Line in middle of UI
[list]
[*] This was an issue because of the resolution issue
[/list]
[*] Menu Camera Bounds
[list]
[*] Updated map bounds but part of this issue was due to the resolution issue
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Sound Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Duplicate Sound Slider
[list]
[*] The main sound slider was mislabeled
[/list]
[/list]
